description: Fold whole groups of sidebar projects, so work projects stay out of sight at home and personal ones stay out of sight at work. Drag a project by its name onto a folder to file it; BB's own project and thread rows stay as they are. A folded folder shows how many projects it holds, and a dot when a thread in it needs you. Folders are shared across your BB clients, and each client remembers which ones it keeps folded.
